tips.text: Finish every stage of the Lvl 40-60 bounty; the final stage pays double the Neuroptics chance of stage 4.
Do the Systems and Chassis bounties first; both usually drop within 3 to 5 runs and clear the quest's build gates.
Aggro the Teralyst without killing it and kill the Vomvalysts it spawns; skip lures, which absorb them.
Pickpocket a second core off each Vomvalyst with Ivara's Prowl before you kill it.
After The New War, Archon Hunts and Narmer Isoplast turn-ins are a passive Quills standing source.
Leave and re-enter Cetus if Nakak has no mask after you rank up; start Mask of the Revenant from the Codex once you buy it.
Do not use Revenant Prime parts or a Helminth-subsumed Revenant; the quest only counts base-frame components you hold.
Buy Revenant from the Market only with the quest already active, or the purchase may not count.
Skip farming Cetus Wisps on purpose; the 4 you need drop from bounties along the way.
Run Plague Star when it is live; it drops Chassis at 14 to 16% against about 9% on non-final bounty stages.
Kill the Revenant Specter with Octavia's Mallet, Mesa's Peacemaker or a forced finisher instead of fighting it.
Re-enter the Plains and redo the finale if the Specter never appears.
Expect 2 to 4 hours if the drops cooperate and up to 16 if Neuroptics does not.
Players agree Neuroptics is the one real wall; Systems and Chassis fall out of a handful of runs.
